text: Code refactoring is the process of improving the structure of existing code without changing what it does. The main goal is to make the code easier to read and understand. When developers refactor, they clean up messy sections, remove unnecessary complexity, and organize things more clearly. This helps the whole team work faster because everyone can follow the logic. Refactoring also reduces technical debt, which builds up when quick fixes are made instead of proper solutions. By taking time to refactor regularly, teams keep their code healthy and avoid bigger problems later. Remember: if the behavior changes, it is not refactoring.
